items.d: The Logistics Squad under your command is proficient in logistics and transportation. Their goal is to transport strategic supplies to Londinium.
The Intel Squad under your command is proficient in reconnaissance and intel analysis. Their goal is to gather intel in Londinium.
The Medical Squad under your command is proficient in emergency response and rescue. Their goal is to offer medical aid in Londinium.
We encountered a strange area where towering Originium clusters obstruct our path. What was once a safe route is now dangerous. Some of the Originium might even be active. Please advise.
We encountered trouble: Originium dust has caused our precision instruments to malfunction. This is particularly concerning in an area prone to minor Catastrophes. Please advise.

We encountered hostile forces in the wastes and are currently at an impasse. They appear to be thugs surviving by robbing refugees. They refuse to negotiate and are threatening us to surrender our supplies. Please advise.

Message from Closure:
'Doctor, the team is currently in an area with no signal coverage, but our readings indicate an imminent Catastrophe. Please advise.'

We ran into some refugees who claim to be settlers of the surrounding wastes. Their settlements were destroyed by Catastrophe, and they are hoping we can provide them supplies to survive on, as they fled with nothing. Please advise.

We have discovered a possible pattern in the onset of minor Catastrophes in certain areas, but this is just speculation with no hard evidence. Some team members have suggested we analyze it based on existing intelligence. Please advise.
Our scouts have discovered a recently abandoned village where we might find usable supplies. Should we go ahead and search the place?
We found the wreckage of a high-speed battleship, likely from previous Victorian reconnaissance forces. It appears unoccupied from a distance. Should we proceed with a search?
Our scouts discovered a dozen or so soldiers in Victorian military attire stationed in a simple camp, presumably deserters. Should we make contact with them?
We observed a sudden golden radiance in the sky, dispersing the lingering crimson clouds. This unexpected event may impact our mission plans. Please advise.

Our scouts have spotted a large Sarkaz contingent on the march, likely an elite unit retreating from the Silverrock Bluffs frontline to Londinium. It might take them some time to fully pass. Please advise.
We are located near Londinium and establishing a dedicated but simple comms base here would benefit the mission. However, conditions are worse than expected, and accidents may occur. Please advise.
We found a child dressed in rags in the wastes, crying out and asking us to help his wounded parents. They are not far from our location, but they may slow us down. Please advise.
We ran into a group of civilians claiming to be refugees from Londinium who dare not return home, but cannot leave the wastes, either. Please advise.
A Sarkaz patrol squad in the distance has spotted us. Estimated contact in five minutes. Please advise.
We are less than a day away from the city, but have also spotted Sarkaz sentry outposts nearby. How should we approach them?

Following a message from Closure, we proceeded to a nearby location for a support mission. We discovered a wrecked transport drone and its cargo, a smart combat platform with the ID: PhonoR-0. The platform is currently offline. Please advise. (Completing the final mission can greatly increase your Logistics Ability)

Doctor, we have connected with the drone dispatched to support PhonoR-0 and are currently modifying it as Closure directed.
However, there is a disagreement: PhonoR-0 wants to be modified and carry out the mission alone, while Closure believes we should continue modifying the drone and work together. Please advise.
We received PhonoR-0's emergency signal. Shrouded in mist and chased by multiple robed enemies, she must have been attacked by Nachzehrers. We're en route to assist. Please advise.

We received an encrypted signal from a Rhodes Island standard beacon. It contains important content that requires physical recovery of the beacon to view. However, we detected Sarkaz troops while en route to the beacon. Please advise on how we should proceed. (Completing the final mission can greatly increase your Intel Ability)

Based on clues from the message, we discovered a secret hideout in some ruins, along with the beacon and its deceased courier, who happened to be an Infected. There were other refugees present who, despite being extremely cautious, did not attack us. We have retrieved the beacon and will investigate the courier's cause of death. Please advise on how to handle the refugees.

We deciphered the beacon's encrypted message and found a clue from Operator Ch'en. The deceased Infected had been hunted down for killing Sarkaz and was saved by Ch'en, who suggested he seek help from Rhodes Island. She also left a set of coordinates in the message. As we approached, we could see a deserted camp in the distance. Please advise.
Sure enough, we found another clue left by Operator Ch'en. Again, we retrieved the beacon and attempted to decipher its message.

We met a non-hostile group of Sarkaz mercenaries who recognized us and even invited us to raid the nearby Sarkaz altar guarded by Confessarii. Their team emblem is an unusual smiley face, and they carry numerous explosives. Please advise. (Completing the final mission can greatly increase your Medical Ability)
We found traces of the Confessarius bodyguards again. There are only Originium clusters and Confessarius corpses in this area. We're guessing a fierce battle took place here recently. Please advise.

We came across a Self-Salvation Corps camp while catching up to the Followers. They were attacked on their way to the city and suffered heavy losses. They sent a distress signal and a doctor responded, but have lost contact.
A small group of Sarkaz troops are currently headed their way, so how should we aid them?

We followed clues related to the Followers and received a distress signal from a Rhodes Island beacon. We followed it to a Confessarius laboratory. Sarkaz often patrol the area, so we don't have much time to explore. What kind of information should we focus on?

Our team is almost at Londinium. We were figuring out a way to enter the heavily fortified city when the special communication equipment from Operator Shining received a strange signal. Please advise.
Reconsider your route. You currently do not have enough resources to cut a straight path through.

items.d: Your goal is to help those in need and minimize tragedies. Act with caution—it's hard to tell what lies in store for us.
items.d2: We have entered the warzone and can clearly see Originium clusters in the strange weather. We will provide live updates on any further encounters. Please be ready to advise.

items.d: There's no time to formulate a detailed plan. You must try to cross the Catastrophe forecast region right away.
items.d2: Your prediction was spot-on: giant Originium clusters emerged in the Catastrophe forecast region as soon as the storm hit. Fortunately, we acted swiftly and avoided the area in advance.

items.d: With your squad’s ample experience and resources, the incoming Catastrophe will pose little threat.
items.d2: Your prediction was spot-on: the Catastrophe was manageable. We exited the region after using some supplies.

items.d: You have enough supplies to find a way around these soldiers and another path forward.
items.d2: Under the strange sky, those soldiers looked as weary as we did. Per your directions, we took a detour and avoided their camp. Although it cost more time and resources, fortunately, there were no casualties.

items.d: Based on your intel, I have analyzed their activity zones and patrol routes. There should be a path here that allows safe and rapid passage.
items.d2: Following your instructions, we crossed their camp unseen during their shift change. Their supplies were low, and their gear was damaged.

items.d: You can offer them medical aid in exchange for passage. Rhodes Island Operators tend to the sick and wounded anywhere and should not turn a blind eye here.
items.d2: Per your instructions, we declared our intention, and the two desperate troops invited us into their camp. Most of the soldiers were severely injured, the best we could do was provide basic medical aid and leave them some medicine before departing.

items.d: You can improvise and build makeshift wall-scaling gear from the available supplies.
items.d2:
We climbed the city outskirts and reached the edge of the plate next to the city. Our makeshift equipment allowed us to bring most of our supplies. The area was eerily quiet despite the many wrecked buildings. As we searched, it became clear that residents had left in a hurry. In one apartment, we found broken and stained dolls on the dinner table, evidence of their hasty departure. Something feels off about this place, but we're determined to complete the mission.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned. Wish us luck.

items.d: You have collected ample intel on Londinium and its surroundings. I can now formulate the final step of this operation.
items.d2:
We have arrived at the city's auxiliary plates following your route. The mobility layer here is neglected, with broken equipment scattered everywhere. Fortunately, the support structures remain stable, so there's no risk of collapse. In the support layer, we found many residents who fled their homes. A stable society has formed here due to the long-term unrest above. Many fear the Sarkaz and are unwilling to return to the residential layer, describing the city as chaotic. Nevertheless, it remains our objective. We provided necessities to this 'city within a city' before moving on. We are currently heading to the city office as planned.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned. Please keep comms clear.

items.d: You can try traversing the no man's land filled with active Originium to reach the city perimeter.
items.d2:
In the area with the highest active Originium concentrations, we encountered Sarkaz mercenaries who had retreated from the Redmane Mountains and were left to die in the wastes. They refused our medical aid. When a sudden catastrophe struck, we gave them our equipment. Afterward, some mercenaries decided to join us on our journey to the city in exchange for more supplies, despite being labeled 'traitors' by their peers.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned, and our team is stronger than when we first set out.

items.d: Your team is adequately prepared and can try to charge straight to the final objective point.
items.d2:
On our way to the Londinium outskirts, we encountered three groups of people. The first group comprised refugees who had fled the city long ago but were stranded on the outskirts due to difficult terrain. They seemed mentally well and adequately supplied, playing cards and chatting as we passed. Closer to the city, we met armed Victorian soldiers, their physical and mental strain evident. Lastly, we came across a distraught group of Londinium residents who had just fled the city. They were in a dire state, trembling as they described how the city was littered with Londinier and Sarkaz corpses and how the remaining survivors were on the brink of collapse. We fear the worst for Londinium.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned. Hopefully, things are slightly better there.

items.d: This operation is already in the bag. I have countless contingency plans to guarantee its success.
items.d2:
We ultimately decided to follow the Confessarius's tracks and entered the city via a hidden passage, bringing all our supplies into Londinium. The war ravaged city faces multiple crises: its resources depleted, its people weary, and its future uncertain. We distributed our supplies to those in dire need, though many still remain unhelped. We've also received news that other Rhodes Island teams are arriving in Londinium. Hopefully, our efforts will make a difference.
We are currently executing our mission as planned; thank you for your unwavering support and guidance.
